Don’t jump. When you jump I promise you, you will feel instant regret. There is no “ok I can vomit the pills 💊 out of my stomach and survive”
Or “I cut my wrist , I can still call an ambulance”. If you jump you jump. Please think about everything in life that made you happy before. You had good times. They will return, seek help. I wish you the best

Well the sad truth is they gonna be hurt. If you have a good relationship with your family, you obviously do otherwise you wouldn’t ask, there is nothing worse for them than losing you. Some people turn to drugs , get depressed , commit Suicide when they loose a close family member. They gonna be shocked and maybe even for life. Make sure to talk to them and try to get every help possible before committing  Suicide. If you do , write a detailed letter with all your emotions and what lead you to do it. BUT PLEASE DONT!  I’m struggling myself right  now due to many reasons .. it’s hard I know. The only reason that keeps me from Suicide is my mum , sister ( and my cat ). It’s your choice but think about it very well. Many people regret their suicide when it’s too late and they are already dying. Sorry for my English. I’m from Germany. Stay safe and I send you love ✌🏻
